name: Editable limits, labelled approximate values and checks that say what they covered
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.7 lets you see and change every size, time and count limit, marks mesh-based values as approximate and says plainly when a check could not run.

highlights.title: Every limit editable in Settings
highlights.text: Help > Settings > Limits lists each size, time and count limit the app applies, with its unit and default. Change any of them; when one stops or shortens a job, the message names it.

highlights.title: Approximate values are labelled
highlights.text: Measurements and bounding boxes taken from the tessellated mesh are marked approximate, and a check that could not run reads 'not evaluated' with the reason.

highlights.title: Mass properties show what is missing
highlights.text: Mass Properties counts the bodies it left out and why, BOM mass shows an unknown volume or density as unavailable, and densities come only from materials you assigned or the file states.

highlights.title: DXF import finds hidden layers
highlights.text: Direct DXF Preflight finds layers that are off or frozen and invisible entities, keeps them out of the cut paths until you approve them, and reports entities with unusable coordinates.

highlights.title: Waterjet audit keeps small features
highlights.text: The Waterjet Studio audit keeps short segments, small cutouts and arcs as drawn, and flags contours that stay open, are drawn twice or have gaps wider than the gap tolerance before anything is cut.

highlights.title: Third-party notices in Help
highlights.text: Help lists the third-party components bundled in the app with their licences and copyright notices.

notes: Pro tools run in the Windows desktop app with an active trial or licence; the downloaded HTML file runs the Free Basic tools.
Windows desktop app: the licence and the managed policy are checked again while the app is open, and Pro tools close when a licence ends.

Windows desktop app and Native Kit: the native SolidWorks and NX helper starts only with an active licence and a helper set up for it; the Native Kit launcher uses the helper set up for its own version.

AI endpoints: requests are not followed across redirects, plain http to another computer needs a per-host confirmation, and an image request is sent again automatically only after a 429, 503 or 529 reply.
All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversion and renders run on your computer; no model is uploaded.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md and the third-party notices; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
